matt_support: FYI customer reported their indexing backfill started failing ~10:20 UTC. Index rejects incoming vectors (dim 1536) but index was created for 1024. Also seeing intermittent 401s from the embeddings API and a huge billing spike from retries. Logs below.

lina_eng_ml: Was there a model swap recently for that customer? 1536 usually means a new embed model.

matt_support: Yes, they upgraded to openclaw-1.3 last night. Example request they ran: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"openclaw-1.3","input":["doc text"]}'` They report 401 on ~10% of requests and the index rejects the rest with dim errors.

raj_engineering: 401 + retries => duplicate billing. Need request_id and indexer logs. Do we have a sample request_id?

matt_support: request_id r-0a1b2c3. Pasted indexer log snippet:```
ERROR indexer: upsert failed id=acme-doc-42 reason="dimension mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536"
WARN auth: service_key id sk-1234 unauthorized for project acme (token invalid)
WARN api: retrying request request_id=r-0a1b2c3 status=401 attempts=3 backoff=2s
ERROR indexer: partial write: 72/1000 documents inserted
```

indexer-bot: Migration status: v3_schema migration in progress for acme-index. Current active index dims=1024. Incoming vectors labelled dims=1536. Inserts blocked until migration completes or a compatible index exists.

lina_eng_ml: Two independent issues: (A) embedding model change increased vector width to 1536, (B) some client tokens are expired/rotated causing 401 and retries. Short-term mitigations: 1) block or short-circuit requests that return mismatched dims at the gateway (so customers don't waste tokens), 2) instruct customer to roll back to previous embedding model (openclaw-1.1) for the backfill, or re-embed payloads with the new model after creating 1536-index.

mike_ops: For 401s we should identify the service key used. If it's a deleted user or rotated key, issue a fresh service token and ask customer to switch. Also temporarily disable automatic retry for 401/403 on the backfill worker to stop billing amplification. I'll set retry_policy=no-retry for client-facing backfill job routes.

matt_support: Customer asked for minimal repro steps and an index CLI snippet to show the dim check failing so they can reproduce locally. Can we provide a clear repro?

raj_engineering: Repro steps (minimal):```
# get embeddings (simulate customer)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"openclaw-1.3","input":["test doc"]}' | jq .data[0].embedding | wc -c # should indicate 1536 dims

# attempt index upsert (local indexer cli)
indexer-cli upsert --index acme-index --id test-doc --vector <paste_vector_here>
# expected output:
# ERROR: dimension mismatch (expected 1024, got 1536)
```

lina_eng_ml: Longer-term: consider graceful dimension fallback or auto-provisioning of a secondary index with the new dim and a mapping layer. For now recommend one of two paths to customer: A) Recreate index with dims=1536 and run backfill (if they can afford re-ingest) or B) Roll back to openclaw-1.1 for the backfill and schedule a controlled migration window.

mike_ops: Implemented immediate changes: set gateway to return 422 for dim mismatch (no retry), disabled retries for 401/403 from backfill-worker pool, and added a short-circuit that records billing-safe metrics. Patching now.

matt_support: I'll reply with both rollback + repro instructions and offer help to rotate the service key. Tagging oncall for potential SLA/latency impact.

oncall_bot: Paging oncall_eng_sre — incident candidate if customer reports sustained SLA breach.

matt_support: Thanks all — I'll update this thread with customer decision and request ids for any follow-ups.
